{{Otheruses|Strangle vine}}
'''Strangle vines''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. They were strong and invasive, and fully capable of penetrating the perimeter walls of [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] and crushing them.
